name: When should I consider a full bathroom renovation instead of minor updates?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a full bathroom renovation instead of minor updates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a full bathroom renovation if your current bathroom has significant functional issues like outdated plumbing, water damage, or an inefficient layout. If the entire space feels worn out, doesn't meet your family's needs, or you're planning to stay in your home long-term, a complete overhaul provides the most impactful transformation and value. Minor updates are better for purely aesthetic changes or temporary fixes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for a full renovation when facing major functional issues, water damage, or layout problems, or if the entire space is outdated. Minor updates suit aesthetic changes.
